text:
incident-bot: ALERT: elevated 5xx rate on /v1/generate (hosted-us-east1). rate: ~6% over baseline — routing alert triggered, paging primary oncall. doc: https://console.redwood.ai/runbooks/inference-5xx

Aisha (oncall): taking this live. I'm primary for the next 30m. quick triage: dashboards show spike aligns with increased prefix cache evictions on the hosted fleet. latency slightly up on the same hosts.

Tom K: on desktop, can help with traffic shaping and model fallback. where's the most recent mitigation play?

Aisha (oncall): runbook link above. TL;DR: reduce hosted weight for /v1/generate, enable fallback to cpu-quant model variant for non-latency-sensitive customers, flush unhealthy worker groups. quick commands in runbook.

Leah R: FYI customer-impact: two enterprise customers reported errors in production (support tickets 4231, 4232). partial failures only — embeddings and other routes unaffected.

Aisha (oncall): mitigation steps I'm doing now:
- mark group eu-west1/hosted-42 as degraded in routing table
- apply temporary traffic shift to dedicated pools
- trigger cache-check and avoid full KV eviction

Mike Ops: pinging infra to bump ephemeral capacity on dedicated pool while we shift traffic. @infra-team: can we provision +2 nodes in pool rdx-ded-1 for next 45m? :eyes:

incident-bot: NOTE: fallback policy executed on 3 requests to preserve latency SLA; model-variant: gptq-2_7b-cpu.

Tom K: applying traffic-shape now. command (ops endpoint):
```
POST /internal/traffic-shaper
payload: route=/v1/generate&hosted_weight=20&dedicated_weight=80
```
Executed. monitoring.

Aisha (oncall): confirming reduced 5xxs down to ~1.2% in the last 2m. latency stable. keeping primary until handoff window.

Leah R: filing follow-ups: created ticket TKT-5998 to investigate root cause of increased cache evictions; TKT-5999 for improving runbook run-through and a playbook item to pre-warm KV cache on scale events.

Aisha (oncall): handoff plan: I'll stay on until 15:40 UTC then hand to Tom as primary, Leah as secondary. outstanding: diag logs to gather (stack traces, worker mem pressure), and patch the routing rule to auto-failover earlier.

Tom K: acknowledged. I'll own the post-handoff check and lead the retro. scheduling: can we do a 30-min postmortem async plus 1hr retro tomorrow at 17:00 UTC?

Leah R: yes, add calendar invite. I'll take action item to add clearer metrics to the console (cache eviction rate per host).

Aisha (oncall): action items recap:
- Aisha: upload collected logs and eviction timeline to TKT-5998 (done before handoff).
- Tom: runbook updates for traffic-shaper example and fallback thresholds (TKT-5999).
- Leah: console metric dashboard + alert tuning (TKT-6000).

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: 5xx rate reduced below alert threshold. monitoring for 30m.

Tom K: taking over as primary now — thanks Aisha. leaving note: if 5xxs creep up again, revert hosted_weight to 15% and open direct channel with infra.

Aisha (oncall): handoff complete. thanks team. :thumbsup:

Leah R: retro invite sent.

Mike Ops: provisioning confirmed — +2 nodes added for 45m. will release after we confirm stability.

Tom K: closing thread; will update tickets and write short incident summary in #postmortems after retro.
